title: HumanDecisionRequired and Decision Inbox

producer_attempts.definition: IMPLEMENT invocations that published a candidate; excludes two authority-blocked invocations and the closure invocation

blocking_findings_count.definition: verifier-numbered blocking findings under 'Why this is (still) a REJECT': 4 + 2 + 3 + 3 + 1; 0 at ACCEPT. Items the verifier explicitly labelled restated, minor or producer-judgment are excluded.

findings_by_class.note: evidence-local classification of the verifier's prose findings; not v1 schema authority

candidate_added_lines_by_cycle.definition: added lines of each candidate against its own parent, from Git. Cycles 2-4 were re-implementations on the release baseline, so their parent-relative figures are not comparable with cycles 5-6, which are descendant repairs.

authority_interruptions.definition: two FOUNDER_EXCEPTIONs, both raised on the same ground

human_decisions_required.scope: the coordinator supplied the missing release record and stated the omission was its own; no Founder decision was requested or supplied

coordinator_defect_authority_blocks.definition: both interruptions were caused by a release performed without the release record PY-02..PY-06 each carried

human_attention_blocked_seconds.definition: first FOUNDER_EXCEPTION comment 16:56:31Z to the release-authorization comment 17:09:57Z; spans both refusals and both liveness recoveries

liveness_incidents.definition: two LIVENESS_GAP records for issue 55, at state ages 459 s and 539 s against a 300 s grace

operator_interventions.definition: two operator status re-emissions IMPLEMENT -> READY -> IMPLEMENT applied as liveness recovery

attention_items.definition: judgment-required durable attention items: two FOUNDER_EXCEPTION items and three repeated-rejection threshold items. Excludes the DONE_TO_DONE notification.

candidate_custody_failures.scope: six published candidates; the verifier fetched each named ref independently into a fresh worktree and confirmed the tip equals the claimed SHA

architecture_violations.scope: architecture fitness PASS reproduced by the verifier at every candidate, against both --root src and --root src/alienintent

behavioral_regression_count.definition: cycle 5 introduced a defect in its own repair: cancelled-by-decision was not terminal, so a cancelled BIU was re-dispatched and completed by the next loop tick

candidate_lineage.definition: cycles 2, 3 and 4 were not descendants of the rejected candidate; cycles 5 and 6 were, the switch recorded in commit 822ca38 'start PY-07 repair cycle 5 from rejected candidate'

proven_red_evidence.cycle_6_accept: reverting only factory_coordinator.py to the parent makes the candidate's own new regression test fail with the exact cycle-5 defect

total_elapsed_seconds.definition: READY -> IMPLEMENT transition 16:54:46Z to DONE observation 19:59:03Z

implementation_elapsed_seconds.definition: sum of the six candidate-producing PRODUCER invocation durations; excludes the 113 s and 102 s authority-blocked invocations and the 266 s closure invocation

verification_elapsed_seconds.definition: sum of the six VERIFIER invocation durations

node_suite.observed_by_verifier: runtime 310/310, preflight PASS, RAI 18/18, policy 2/2, exit 0
node_suite.note: PY-07 verifications ran `node scripts/check.mjs all` rather than `npm test`, so the 310/330 discrepancy seen in PY-05 and PY-06 does not arise

provider_capacity_failures.scope: no capacity failure appears in Issue #55 comments or the observation log

known_provider_model.note: the dispatcher state record carries no provider or model field

repair_mode.basis: blocking findings 4 -> 2 -> 3 -> 3 -> 1 -> 0. The same Scope §2 requirement was reported unsatisfied in three consecutive cycles (2, 3, 4) in three different shapes while the candidate was rebuilt from the baseline each time. Convergence coincides with cycle 5, the first repair taken from the rejected candidate rather than restarted from the baseline.

recurring_failure_class.label: an escalation that is registered but not decidable - recorded, reported, not recoverable
recurring_failure_class.note: the same dead-end shape appeared at the admission path, the unresolved-effect path, the worker-raised path and the defer disposition. Each occurrence was a different code path; the class was the same.

unknown_metrics: per-cycle candidate diff for cycles 2-4 measured against a common base
